Endermolift™ 2 – Anti-Wrinkle Treatments

A 100% natural, anti-wrinkle and rejuvenating technique for women and men of all ages. Significantly improves skin condition, reducing wrinkles and stimulating the skin to produce collagen.

Prices are indicative — the final quote is set during the consultation.

The goals of Endermolift® facial treatments are:

  • brightening
  • filling
  • firming
  • skin densification


Endermolift™ is a non-invasive technique that addresses the main causes of skin aging and loss of skin density.

The patient undergoes a painless treatment in individually tailored series.

LPG Lifts delivers micro-impulses to the skin surface, which then penetrate deeper, triggering a biological response from fibroblasts and reactivating the natural production of collagen and elastin.

Endermolift™ – discover the treatment results

Endermolift™ improves venous-lymphatic circulation and removes fibrous barriers to facilitate tissue oxygenation. It is designed for thin, aging skin showing signs of sagging.

Endermolift® uses the patented LIFT Technology, which works through the synergistic action of two flaps in the treatment chamber of the handpiece and sequential skin suction to stimulate peripheral tissue.
